pages.title: Princess Zelda in Her Royal Gown and Tiara Holding the Triforce of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda holds the Triforce of Wisdom in this printable coloring page, wearing her royal gown and tiara with long hair flowing behind her shoulders. Triangular earrings, decorated cuffs, and an ornate front gown panel add small sections beside the wide skirt, while distant castle towers rise beyond the terrace.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Swimming Up Stacked Water Block Echoes From Echoes of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Princess Zelda swimming up stacked Water Block Echoes from Echoes of Wisdom, reaching one hand upward as bubbles surround her flowing hair. Three rounded water blocks create broad transparent-looking sections, while her jeweled headband, necklace, belt, and patterned gown panel add smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Rescuing Tri's Friends on the Floating Islands of the Still World from Echoes of Wisdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda rescues Tri's friends on the Still World's floating islands in this printable coloring page, holding one small companion while two others hover nearby. Her braided crown, flowing cape, and patterned gown add detail around the figures, while fractured island edges, clouds, and ruined columns fill the surrounding scene.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Disguised as Sheik Playing the Harp From Ocarina of Time Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Zelda disguised as Sheik playing a harp from Ocarina of Time, wearing a wrapped head covering and cloth face mask. The chest eye emblem, bandaged forearms, and harp's curled frame provide smaller sections, while fitted clothing and long fabric ties create broader enclosed shapes.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Trapped Inside a Crystal in Ganondorf's Castle From Ocarina of Time Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda is trapped inside a crystal in Ganondorf's Castle in this printable coloring page, pressing both open hands outward within the tall faceted enclosure. Her tiara and decorated gown panel add fine details to the Ocarina of Time scene, while the crystal's stone base and surrounding columns provide larger geometric sections.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Trapped in Yuga's Painting From a Link Between Worlds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Princess Zelda trapped in Yuga's painting from A Link Between Worlds, with clasped hands inside a tall decorative picture frame. Curled leaves, diamond ornaments, and a Triforce crest surround the portrait, while the gown's front emblem, flowing hair, and long sleeve folds create distinct coloring sections.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Giving Link a Shield at the Picori Festival From the Minish Cap Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Zelda gives Link a shield at the Picori Festival in this printable coloring page, with both characters holding the small shield beneath hanging triangular pennants. Vertical plank lines and round studs detail the shield, while Zelda's long gown, jeweled headpiece, and Link's pointed cap and boots provide broader coloring areas.

pages.title: Princess Zelda in Her Battle Armor Wielding a Rapier From Hyrule Warriors Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Zelda wielding a rapier in her Hyrule Warriors battle armor, with one arm extended beneath long hair and braided front sections. Decorated shoulder plates, fitted bracers, and tall armored boots add small enclosed patterns, while the flowing skirt panels provide broader areas around the slender blade.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Giving Peace Sign in Modern Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute printable coloring page depicting Princess Zelda winking and making a peace sign, wearing a crop top, belted skirt with a chain, and a Triforce pendant necklace.

pages.title: Princess Zelda with High Ponytail Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features a cute close-up portrait of Princess Zelda looking back over her shoulder with a high ponytail, braided headband, and big expressive eyes.

pages.title: Chibi Princess Zelda Sitting in Hoodie Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute printable coloring page depicting chibi Princess Zelda sitting curled up in an oversized hoodie with pointed elf ears and a relaxed face.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Making Hand Heart Gesture Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute printable coloring page featuring a happy Princess Zelda forming a heart shape with her hands surrounded by small floating hearts and sparkles.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Cheerful Smile Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: Focused on a close-up portrait of Princess Zelda smiling brightly with fanged teeth, this printable coloring page shows her long hair, pointed elf ears, and ornate collar necklace.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Smiling in Hooded Cloak Coloring Page
pages.description: This detailed printable coloring page features a close-up of Princess Zelda wearing a hooded cloak, smiling gently with blushed cheeks and holding a lock of her short hair.

pages.title: Anime Elf Princess Zelda in Maid Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Zelda dressed as an anime elf maid in a ruffled outfit, standing indoors beside a potted plant with a sweet expression.

pages.title: Chibi Princess Zelda in Armor Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute printable coloring page depicting Princess Zelda in stylized armor with flowing hair, patterned sleeves, and geometric shapes in the background.

pages.title: Princess Zelda Wearing Tiara and Triforce Earrings Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Zelda posing in her detailed royal outfit while wearing an ornate tiara and triangular Triforce earrings.
